MANDY BAGGOT · ROMANTIC FICTION

Love at First Slice

*previously published as Strings Attached*

George Fraser has a mission. Owner of catering firm Finger Food and black sheep of her family, she's determined to succeed in business where she's so far failed in her personal life.

Asked to cater for gorgeous rock star Quinn Blake's after-show party, her life suddenly takes a turn for the dramatic.
